name: MoreButton
purpose: Icon-only convenience action for opening or invoking familiar More actions.

guidance.useWhen: Use when an icon-only "More actions" affordance conventionally represents access to additional actions.
guidance.avoidWhen: Avoid for labelled business actions or when the control does not expose additional actions.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Use only for the familiar More actions utility; prefer Button or IconButton for other actions.

accessibility: Defaults aria-label and tooltip to "More actions"; callers may override aria-label when the context requires a more specific accessible name.
knownLimitations: Avoid as a substitute for labelled business actions; use only for the matching familiar utility action.
